name: log-viewer
title: Log Viewer
description: LogViewer: a live log or terminal output viewer for any process. createLogStore takes lines from anywhere (append, or write for raw chunks with partial lines) into a bounded buffer and notifies once per frame; the viewer renders only the lines in view, on UI SDK's virtualizer inside a ScrollArea. It follows the end until the reader scrolls up, then shows Jump to end with a count of new lines (End or the button follows again); filters by source (a ToggleGroup, sources coloured with chart or tone colours) and by search; renders ANSI colours on theme tokens; marks error lines (by level or an isError pattern) and steps through them with F8 and Shift+F8; copies the shown lines or a selection as plain text; wraps on demand. A role=log with aria-live off and a polite status that announces new errors at most every 5 seconds. Agents read the shown lines and call filter, search, nextError, previousError, copy, jumpToEnd and setWrap.
docs: Create the store once, outside render: `const store = createLogStore({ maxLines: 10000 })`. Feed it from anywhere: `store.append({ text, source: "backend", level: "error", time })` for whole lines, or `store.write(chunk, { source })` for a process's raw output (partial lines wait for the rest, colours carry across lines per source). Then `<LogViewer store={store} label="Environment output" sources={["frontend", "backend", { id: "db", label: "postgres" }]} timestamps />` in a box with a height (`className="h-96"` or `min-h-0 flex-1`). `isError={/ERR!|Exception/}` marks lines without a level; `hiddenSources`, `query` and `wrap` can be controlled with their `on…Change`; `format` writes a line for copy and agents; `actions` adds toolbar buttons; `toolbar={false}` hides the toolbar. Every label is overridable through `labels`.
